historicalFinancialImpact: none; no reporting mappings are inferred

changes.name: Beer
changes.description: Sold beer, including draught, packaged and explicitly alcohol-free beer. Excludes steak, wine, spirits and beer used as a recipe ingredient; porterhouse is a food counterexample.

changes.name: Weekly Specials
changes.description: Prepared food explicitly evidenced as a dated or weekly special. Excludes regular mains, drinks and ingredients; a steak name alone is not evidence of a special.

changes.name: Wings
changes.description: Prepared chicken-wing dishes sold to guests. Excludes raw poultry, wing sauce ingredients and non-wing mains; a stock carton of chicken is an ingredient.

changes.name: Desserts
changes.description: Prepared sweet dishes sold as desserts, including historical menu desserts. Excludes coffee, dessert wine and bulk sugar; a latte is a beverage.

changes.name: Liqueurs
changes.description: Sold liqueur servings. Excludes base spirits, cocktails and cooking ingredients; an espresso martini belongs in Cocktails.

changes.name: Wine
changes.description: Sold wine servings and bottles, including fortified and sparkling wine. Excludes cocktails, merchandise and wine used only in cooking; a wine-branded shirt is Merchandise.

changes.name: Soft Drinks
changes.description: Sold soft drinks, juices and mixers served as drinks. Excludes alcohol, coffee and bulk ingredient syrups; a gin-and-tonic cocktail is not a soft drink.

changes.name: Spirits
changes.description: Sold spirit servings, excluding liqueurs and composed cocktails. Excludes ingredient-only alcohol and merchandise; a margarita belongs in Cocktails.

changes.name: Non-Alcoholic
changes.description: Sold non-alcoholic drinks other than explicitly evidenced Soft Drinks or Beer, including tea and coffee. Excludes milk ingredients and modifiers; oat-milk substitution alone is a modifier. Coffee does not establish cafe membership.

changes.name: Functions
changes.description: Items explicitly associated with functions, including food, drinks, packages and charges. This is a browsing context, not a food/beverage allocation. Mixed packages remain unknown for financial reporting; a room-hire charge is not food.

changes.name: Merchandise
changes.description: Physical retail goods such as branded shirts, caps and tote bags. Excludes food, drinks, donations and raffle entries; a beer-branded cap remains merchandise and OTHER revenue.

changes.name: Cocktails
changes.description: Composed mixed drinks sold as cocktails, including explicitly alcohol-free cocktails. Excludes straight spirit servings, bulk syrups and food; a shot of gin belongs in Spirits.

changes.name: Raffle Tickets
changes.description: Paid raffle entries. Excludes donations, merchandise and drinks; a ticket bundled with unspecified food/drink is held for review rather than split by assumption.

changes.name: Donations
changes.description: Explicit voluntary contributions without a sold food/beverage item. Excludes raffle entries, surcharges and function deposits; a meal fundraiser package needs separate review.

changes.name: Mains
changes.description: Prepared regular food dishes sold to guests, including steaks and historical menu dishes. Excludes explicitly evidenced weekly specials, wings, desserts, modifiers and bulk ingredients; porterhouse is included, porter beer is excluded.

changes.name: Ingredients
changes.description: Stock and preparation ingredients without evidence of a guest-facing sold dish. Excludes ready-to-eat menu dishes and explicit modifiers; a carton of raw chicken is included, served wings are excluded.

changes.name: Modifiers
changes.description: Explicit additions, substitutions or preparation choices attached to a sold item. Excludes standalone dishes and stock ingredients; a vegan substitution is not automatically a meal or evidence of cafe identity.

changes.name: Other charges
changes.description: Explicit non-food/beverage charges not covered by Donations, Raffle Tickets or Merchandise. Excludes mixed packages unless the charge itself is identified; room hire is included, a mixed function package remains held.
